model_configuration: Model ID is required and configurable; fixture IDs are synthetic.
facilitator_key_model_access: unverified; no live request or credential lookup performed

request_contract.authentication: HTTP Bearer; production loader uses API_KEY
request_contract.output_format: text.format json_schema; strict true; unchanged supplied schema
request_contract.source_placement: user input_text, separate from trusted instructions

response_contract.completion: Require completed response and completed assistant message before using output_text content.
response_contract.refusal: A refusal content item prevents extraction, including when text accompanies it.
response_contract.interruption: Incomplete/cancelled or still pending output is never treated as completed extraction.
response_contract.errors: HTTP failures and response.error prevent extraction; no implicit retry.
response_contract.provenance: Use observed returned model; no response source is inferred before an envelope is usable.
